**Stable ID:** `DATA-03.05` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 03 Modality coverage

Define identity, metadata and coverage rules for time-series, tabular and geospatial datasets, including units, sampling and coordinate systems.

## Deliverables

- Profiles for time-series, tabular and geospatial data
- Unit, sampling-interval and coordinate-reference fields

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`
- `schemas/modalities/structured.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Profiles cite the standards they adopt for units and coordinate references

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Units and coordinate reference systems are explicit
- [ ] Temporal coverage records precision
- [ ] Validator enforces the profiles

## Non-goals

- Hosting sample rows or tiles

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-03.05.T1` Draft profiles
  - [ ] `DATA-03.05.T1.S1` Define time-series sampling and unit fields
  - [ ] `DATA-03.05.T1.S2` Define tabular schema-description fields
  - [ ] `DATA-03.05.T1.S3` Define geospatial CRS and extent fields
- [ ] `DATA-03.05.T2` Encode
  - [ ] `DATA-03.05.T2.S1` Write modality schemas
  - [ ] `DATA-03.05.T2.S2` Add fixtures and tests

- Blocked by `DATA-01.02` Dataset taxonomy and controlled vocabularies
